bifrost: springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (single audio service), springboard/src/media/route.rs (Speaker/Headphones output route), springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music.rs (route glyph only)
summary: AVRouting lets an app add third-party media receivers to the system route picker (AirPlay-style) through custom routing controllers, routing events and action items, and arbitrates playback between participants. BifrOSt has no route picker, no third-party receiver discovery and no playback arbitration API; the only routing is a local speaker/headphone switch in the audio layer.

features.feature: System route picker with custom destinations
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 3 (w3-avrouting, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no picker UI for media receivers; the Music app draws an AirPlay-like glyph (springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music.rs) that is decorative and opens nothing

features.note: The extension host runs app extensions but has no discovery point that reports a receiver to the shell. springboard/ui/src/route_picker.rs takes discovered receivers as input, and nothing supplies them yet. Blocked on a discovery extension point in the shell.

features.apple: not part of AVRouting (AVAudioSession / AVRouteDetector in other frameworks)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/os_services/output_route.rs (Router, Route, RouteChange, HEADPHONE_CAP); springboard/src/media/route.rs (Router: Speaker and Headphones with per-route volume)
features.note: Jack-driven route changes, the headphone volume cap and per-route volumes are tested headless. Gap: only the built-in card is modelled, with no Bluetooth or network output, and the mixer is not driven from this model.

gaps: No system route picker or AirPlay-style destination list in the shell or SDK
No API for an app to register a third-party media receiver, its authorization, or its route activation state
No playback arbiter: apps cannot declare a preferred participant for external or non-mixable output
No discovery extension point for media receivers on the local network
